The breastplate features a high-gloss reflective surface, embossed decorative patterns with gold/bronze accents on the lower right, and visible rivets near the shoulder straps. To the right, a portion of a helmet or morion with a leather band containing text is visible. The background consists of blurred wooden structures and other metallic armor components.
